_comment: v2.4.1 was pinned previously and is superseded: it predates the fixes in the v2.6.x / v3.x
lines, and a signing tool with known defects is not an acceptable root of a provenance gate.
v3.1.3 is the current patched release and defaults to the standardized Sigstore bundle format,
which is what this gate reads and writes everywhere - one format, one binary, one path used by
signing and by every verification step.
